title: Varun Kumar joins Anant Raj Limited as Head – Legal
description: Real estate and infrastructure law professional Varun Kumar has joined Anant Raj Limited as Head – Legal.A graduate of the Faculty of Law, University of Delhi, Kumar has nearly two decades of experience across litigation, arbitration, insolvency, regulatory affairs, corporate advisory and complex real estate transactions.
